messages:
nate_csm: FYI we detected ingestion delays between 06:40	6:55 PDT impacting ~21 tenants; 5 are flagged high-touch with imminent renewals. Need comms + mitigation offer.

maria_cs: Thanks Nate. Can we confirm cause before sending anything too technical? Tone should be proactive and offer prioritized re-runs.

kevin_sre: Root cause: upstream object-store 5xx spikes triggered aggressive retries in our batch worker. We applied immediate rate-limiting at 07:10 and throughput recovered by 07:40. Full fix (retry jitter + idempotency) ETA ~30 hours.

anya_support: Tickets created CS-8380..CS-8400. Support runbook: only re-run on explicit request with the original upload ID to avoid duplicates. Calendar slots ready for priority re-runs.

maria_cs: Drafting two short templates	6 high-touch and trial. Pasting: 

maria_cs: "High-touch: Hi <Name>, were sorry  earlier today your data upload was delayed. Weve mitigated the issue and can prioritize a free re-run this week to avoid any renewal impact. Reply with the upload ID or pick a slot and well run it. Well send a short RCA within 48 hours.

Trial: Hi, you may have seen a brief delay with data uploads this morning. The issue is resolved; reply if you want a re-run. Affected trials will receive a 1-month credit."

nate_csm: Add a short feedback link after re-run and explicit "we will prioritize activation to avoid renewal impact" line for high-touch.

alan_support_bot: Support tickets linked and tagged: onboard-delay-2026-03. Automated outbound queued for trials pending Maria sign-off.

kevin_sre: Please include upload ID + timestamp in re-run requests. Eng will publish an RCA draft in 48h and post the timeline to customers soon after.

maria_cs: Action items: 1) Ill approve trial outbound in 20m, 2) Nate will send the 5 high-touch emails now, 3) Support to re-run on request with upload ID, 4) Eng to post RCA draft within 48h, 5) Trials get 1-month credit, high-touch get prioritized activation.

anya_support: Standing by for re-runs. Will update CS tracker with any customer replies.
